findings.claim: New diagnostics MsgPack019-022 are Error severity and the analyzer's SupportedDiagnostics now includes them. The AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md and docs for MsgPack019-022 are not in the diff, so the RS2000 release-tracking warning/error would fire in the build. The help-link URIs also point to doc pages that are not added. Because the diagnostics only fire on the new attribute, existing users are not affected, but the analyzer project itself may fail to build.

receipt_plan.detail: Check that AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md lists MsgPack019-022 and that doc/analyzers/MsgPack019.md through MsgPack022.md exist. Neither is in the diff.

findings.claim: The GeneratorUtilities hand-written formatter filter compares the attribute class's ToDisplayString() with a namespace-qualified name. This is harmless for existing users unless a user-defined type named GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute in the MessagePack namespace exists. It does silently exclude any such formatter from the resolver.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the generator snapshot tests for existing custom formatter cases and confirm that the resolver output is unchanged.

findings.claim: Contractless mode excludes public get-only properties and readonly fields, and orders members alphabetically by ordinal name. ContractlessStandardResolver serializes get-only members via a constructor and orders members differently. A type that uses ContractlessStandardResolver today would get a different map from the generated formatter. The requirement asks for contractless behaviour, and ledger L19 says to follow the requirement.

receipt_plan.detail: Take a type with public get-only property A and settable properties C and B. Serialize it with ContractlessStandardResolver and with the generated formatter, then compare the bytes (map keys, order, member count).
